为 LLM 检索而做的搜索 API：除了结果列表，还会给一段现成的答案（输出里的: A search API built for LLM retrieval: besides a list of results, it also returns a ready-made answer (the `answer` field in the output).
发一次最小搜索验证凭证是否可用（会消耗 1 次搜索配额）: Runs a minimal search to verify the credential works (uses 1 search quota)
如 cn / us；留空用上游默认: E.g. cn / us; leave blank to use the upstream default
如 zh-CN / en；留空用上游默认: E.g. zh-CN / en; leave blank to use the upstream default
按关键词搜索网页，返回标题/链接/摘要的列表: Searches the web by keyword and returns a list of titles, links and snippets
要搜索的关键词或问题: The keyword or question to search for
部分上游会给一段现成答案（Tavily / DuckDuckGo 摘要）；没有则: Some upstreams provide a ready-made answer (Tavily / DuckDuckGo summary); otherwise this is empty — the first result is never substituted as an answer
默认 8，上限 20（Google 单次最多 10 条）: Defaults to 8, up to 20 (Google returns at most 10 per request)
